subject: SecurityPkg/Library: use ArmFfaGetPartitionInfo() in Tpm2ServiceFfaLib
reasons: Part of the ArmFfaGetPartitionInfo() migration series (c16f1cc684 introduces the helper; 96ad9bd397, 8955d8db32, b80000847a convert call sites).
Removes the same manual FF-A descriptor lookup boilerplate as the sibling commits, replaced by a single ArmFfaLibGetPartitionInfo (Guid, &Info) call.

Taken individually the commit changes one call path, but across the series the same before/after shape repeats in Tcg2ConfigFfaPeim, MmCommunicationDxe/Pei, and Tpm2ServiceFfaLib, which is enough repetition for a robust rule.
Covered by 96ad9bd397-armffa-get-partition-info.cocci; the Tpm2ServiceFfaRaw test fixture exercises this commit's call site.
candidate_pattern: Replace manual FF-A descriptor partition-info lookup boilerplate (ArmFfaLibPartitionIdGet, ArmFfaLibGetRxTxBuffers, ArmFfaLibPartitionInfoGet with FFA_PART_INFO_FLAG_TYPE_DESC, Rx-buffer descriptor copy and release) with a single ArmFfaLibGetPartitionInfo (Guid, &Info) call
